nom: The Four Nations & the Acts of Union
cartes: St George's Cross adopted by England and London (origin: 10th century)
Act of Union between England and Wales (Henry VIII)
James VI of Scotland becomes James I of England (Elizabeth I dies without an heir)
Act of Union between England and Scotland: parliaments merge, Great Britain is born
Act of Union between Britain and Ireland: Dublin parliament merges with Westminster (UK of Great Britain and Ireland); Union Jack modified
Partition of Ireland: Irish Free State created; 6 northern counties stay in the UK
Stormont Assembly (parliament) set up in Belfast, Northern Ireland
